spec.label: Label of the OpenAPI specification field. Keep OpenAPI.
spec.load: Button that loads a spec from an address.
spec.chooseSpecFile: Accessible label of a button that opens a file picker for a spec file.
spec.browse: Button that opens the spec viewer. Short.
spec.checkForUpdates: Button that compares the collection with the current version of the spec.
spec.browseSpec: Command name that opens the viewer of an imported API spec.
spec.viewerTitle: Title of the spec viewer dialog.
spec.syncTitle: Title of the dialog that lists changes between the spec and the collection.
spec.operations: Tab label. An operation is one endpoint of the API (method and path).
spec.models: Tab label. A model is a data shape (schema) defined in the spec.
spec.sendToTab: Button that opens the selected operation as a request in a new tab.
spec.security: Heading of the section that lists the authentication an operation needs.
spec.required: Small badge next to a parameter or field that must be provided.
spec.deprecated: Small badge next to an operation or field that should no longer be used.
spec.circular: Small note on a model that refers back to itself.
spec.truncated: Small note on a model tree: deeper levels are not shown.
spec.loading: Status text while the spec is being read.
spec.added: Heading of operations that appear in the spec but not in the collection.
spec.changed: Heading of operations whose definition changed in the spec.
spec.removed: Heading of operations that disappeared from the spec.
spec.locallyEdited: Small badge on a request that the person has edited in Gostman after importing it.
spec.apply: Button that applies the ticked changes to the collection.
spec.lint: Tab label. Lint means checking a spec for problems against style and correctness rules.
spec.lintCount: Summary count by severity, for example 3 errors. The info form stays the same in English because it is an abbreviation.
spec.lintHeading: Heading of a group of lint findings by severity, with the number in parentheses.
spec.untagged: Group name for operations that have no tag in the spec.
spec.unchanged: Number of operations with no change, shown beside the synced date.
spec.sourceMissing: Error shown when a collection is linked to no spec address.
spec.keepEditsNote: Explains why some rows are unchecked in the list of changes.
specAlerts.applied: Summary after a sync. {{added}}, {{changed}} and {{removed}} are numbers.
specAlerts.appliedTitle: Title of the dialog shown after a successful sync.
specAlerts.lintTitle: Title of the dialog shown when there is no spec to check. Same as the command name.
spec.close: Button that closes the spec viewer. Verb.
